notes.title: Livestream with TOMYSSHADOW
notes.notes:
When it comes to superfans you won't find one better than TOMYSSHADOW. He has single-handedly ported [b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1723190/Lenny_Loosejocks_Goes_Walkabout]Lenny Walkabout[/url][/b] and [b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1967390/Lenny_Loosejocks_in_Space]Lenny in Space[/url][/b] to Steam. Join him as he gives you a behind-the-scenes tour of Lenny Loosejocks in Space including development stories, tips and tricks, challenges, and how he went from superfan to developer.

In [b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1967390/Lenny_Loosejocks_in_Space]Lenny Loosejocks in Space[/url][/b] you guide Lenny and Donga in their epic quest to save the human race from the evil Sluggees. It's the groundbreaking point-and-click web adventure game sequel to [b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1723190/Lenny_Loosejocks_Goes_Walkabout/]Lenny Loosejocks Goes Walkabout[/url][/b] in all its pixelated glory - exactly like you remember playing when you got home from school in 1998.

Don't forget to download the free [b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1967390/Lenny_Loosejocks_in_Space]DEMO[/url][/b] and add [b]Lenny Loosejocks in Space[/b] to your [b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1967390/Lenny_Loosejocks_in_Space/]wishlist now[/url][/b]!
